label: an approximate reconstruction from the cited claims, not the experiment's geometry
subsystem: Phase-1 barrel pixel detector (BPIX), four layers of sensors

quantities.name: modules
quantities.definition: BPIX modules in the expanded IR (four layers)
quantities.derivation: 96 + 224 + 352 + 512 (detector-atlas:C149, Table 1); built as 12, 28, 44 and 64 ladders of eight modules (C150); 148 ladders (C150) = 1184 / 8

independence.result: a design count from the collaboration's detector paper, not a simulation output; it checks how the ring and linear placements are expressed

negative_control.change: layer 3 with 42 ladders instead of 44 (336 modules)

quantities.name: sensor_x0
quantities.definition: x/X0 of one layer-1 sensor at normal incidence (a geantino along the sensor normal through its centre region)
quantities.derivation: 0.0285 cm (approximately 285 um, detector-atlas:C153) x 2.329 g/cm3 / 21.82 g/cm2 (PDG silicon, eic:C26) = 0.003042

independence.result: independent of Geant4: CMS's design thickness and PDG's tabulation. The paper's material budget (section 2, Figure 3) is a GEANT4 simulation output and the 0.8% X0 of an L2 module does not state its method; neither is used. Geant4 computes radiation lengths with the same Tsai formula, so agreement validates the geometry and the material definition, not Geant4's radiation-length physics.

negative_control.change: the FPIX sensor thickness of 300 um (detector-atlas:C153)

approximations: only the sensors: readout chips, HDI, cables, ladders' carbon-fibre and cooling are not modelled
each module is the full 18.6 x 66.6 mm2 sensor (C152), 285 um thick, as a flat silicon box of PDG density 2.329 g/cm3; the eight modules of a ladder are spaced 540/8 = 67.5 mm along z (C150)

ladders alternate between two radii 2.9 mm apart around the cited average radius of each layer; 2.9 mm is the difference of layer 1's inner two module radii (27.5 and 30.4 mm, C151), used for every layer because the other layers' radii are not sourced (Fig. 16 is a drawing); layer 1's third radius (32.6 mm) and the r-phi overlap of 0.5-1.0 mm are not reproduced
no tilt of the ladders and no tilted or flipped modules
status: comparison with cited values: not validated
